Position Overview

Who we are
 Novelis is driven by its purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together.

As a global leader in innovative products and services and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, we partner with customers in the automotive, beverage can, aerospace and specialties industries to deliver solutions that improve the benefits of balanced lightweight aluminum.

We have a coordinated network of technically sophisticated rolling and recycling plants as well as foundries across 29 facilities in 9 countries throughout North America, South America, Europe, and Asia with 12,750 employees worldwide. The company is headquartered in Atlanta, USA.

Our customers include some of the largest and best-known brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, and others. In addition, Novelis is leading the industry with its sustainability and recycling efforts.

Become part of our mission to create a sustainable world and start in one of our German locations in Göttingen, Koblenz, Nachterstedt, Ohle, Stuttgart or Voerde or in our European Headquarter in Küsnacht , Switzerland as:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

As Senior Predictive Maintenance Engineer you support the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven predictive maintenance and asset-reliability solutions that reduce unplanned downtime and improve equipment reliability across Novelis’ manufacturing operations.

What awaits you:

Technical Development & Delivery

• Develop and deliver components of predictive maintenance and asset-reliability systems, including sensor data preparation, feature engineering, model development, deployment support, and monitoring workflows.

• Build and improve production-grade failure prediction models, equipment health scoring systems, remaining-useful-life (RUL) estimators, and anomaly detection capabilities that surface prioritized, actionable recommendations to maintenance and operations teams.

• Support the scoping, design, and implementation of industrial AI solutions by applying appropriate modeling approaches, evaluation methods, and deployment patterns under the guidance of the Sr. AI Engineer Leader of APM.

• Optimize model performance across the full stack: training efficiency, inference latency, edge compute constraints, and long-term production stability.

• Contribute to model lifecycle management through MLOps practices such as monitoring, drift detection, retraining support, documentation, and rollback procedures.
 Execution Alignment & Enterprise Coordination

• Execute assigned APM work in alignment with Novelis’ enterprise strategic data outcomes, including trusted data, operational reliability, metal flow optimization, 3×30 sustainability goals, and cash focus/operational efficiency.

• Support the enterprise Data & AI Governance framework, ensuring governance is embedded into all workflows and deliverables.

• Support quarterly planning, feature scoping, sprint execution, testing, deployment, and adoption activities aligned to the APM delivery roadmap and KPI framework.
 How you convince us:

• You hold a Master’s degree or advanced certification in AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.

• You have experience in manufacturing, industrial, or sustainability-focused organizations.

• You have at least 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, data science, predictive maintenance, reliability analytics, or industrial AI systems delivery.

• You have experience in developing predictive models using time-series data, sensor data, or equipment telemetry.

• You are proficient in Python and ML frameworks and feel familiar with IoT and OT data.

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Position Overview

Who we are
 Novelis is driven by its purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together.

As a global leader in innovative products and services and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, we partner with customers in the automotive, beverage can, aerospace and specialties industries to deliver solutions that improve the benefits of balanced lightweight aluminum.

We have a coordinated network of technically sophisticated rolling and recycling plants as well as foundries across 29 facilities in 9 countries throughout North America, South America, Europe, and Asia with 12,750 employees worldwide. The company is headquartered in Atlanta, USA.

Our customers include some of the largest and best-known brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, and others. In addition, Novelis is leading the industry with its sustainability and recycling efforts.

Become part of our mission to create a sustainable world and start in our European Headquarter in Küsnacht , Switzerland, in one of our German plants in Göttingen, Koblenz, Nachterstedt or Ohle or in one of our Italian plants in Pieve Emanuele or Bresso as:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

What awaits you:

• You develop the production plan required to meet the service level of our customers.

• You contribute to process improvement and optimization projects.

• Your core responsibilities are:
• Maintain the replenishment strategy at the defined stock level through statistical analysis.

• Optimize delivery of the service level at the lowest possible costs

• Close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders across the organization to improve forecast planning, understanding customer/market needs as well as contribute to process improvement and optimization projects

• Orchestrate metal flow throughout supply chain network incorporating operational targets (i.e. capacity, inventory and cost)

• Develop and operate tools to process scenario models and determining supply chain results

How you convince us:

• You have a university degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Industrial Engineering

• You bring initial experience in Supply Chain and/or Operations management

• You have strong ability to understand complex problems with advanced analytical skills.

• You are a collaborative team player and excellent communicator.

• You are open minded, and solution orientated.

• Fluent communication skills in English and German. French would be a plus

• You have proven knowledge in SAP modules (PDPS, APO DP) and capability to integrate different ERP systems, familiarity with digitalization projects.

 Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.

 Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.
 Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de Sierre , en Suisse
 Mécanicien(-ne) de maintenance
 Pool E 2 MRA (h/f/d)

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Vos responsabilités :

• Participer à l’amélioration, à la mise en service et au maintien de nos outils de production et de nos machines.

• Assurer le service de dépannage des machines et des installations de l’usine.

• Effectuer des travaux d'entretien technique, de montage et de contrôle de qualité sur les installations et équipements des services internes.

• Fabriquer des pièces mécaniques et des pièces mécano-soudées.

• Identifier les problèmes et proposer des solutions, individuellement et en équipe.

• Assurer la documentation des activités de maintenance.

• Travailler avec un tournus de 4 équipes.

• Vous êtes au bénéfice d’expérience dans la maintenance industrielle et/ou dans une industrie similaire.

• Vous êtes titulaire d’un CFC de polymécanicien(ne) ou de constructeur (-trice) d’appareils industriels avec de bonnes compétences mécaniques.

• Vous avez de bonnes connaissances de SAP.

• Vous êtes doté(e) d’un grand sens de l’esprit d’équipe, êtes autonome et orienté(e) solution.

• Vous maîtrisez le français, une autre langue représente un atout.

• Vous êtes à l’aise au sein d’un environnement complexe et êtes capable de vous adapter aux changements.

• Vous êtes précis(e), rigoureux(-se) et méticuleux(-se).

• Mitwirkung an der Verbesserung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen

• Durchführung von Störungsbehebungen an Maschinen und Anlagen im Werk

• Durchführung von technischen Wartungs-, Montage- und Qualitätskontrollarbeiten an den Anlagen und Ausrüstungen der internen Abteilungen

• Fertigung von mechanischen und geschweißten Bauteilen

• Probleme erkennen und Lösungen vorschlagen, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team

• Die Dokumentation der Wartungsarbeiten sicherstellen

• Im 4-Schicht-Wechsel arbeiten

Wie Sie uns überzeugen :
 • Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der industriellen Instandhaltung und/oder in einer ähnlichen Branche.
• Sie besitzen ein CFC als Polymechaniker/in oder als Konstrukteur/in von Industrieanlagen und verfügen über gute mechanische Fähigkeiten.
• Sie verfügen über gute SAP-Kenntnisse.
• Sie zeichnen sich durch ausgeprägten Teamgeist aus, arbeiten selbstständig und sind lösungsorientiert.
• Sie beherrschen Französisch, eine weitere Sprache ist von Vorteil.

Location Profile

Novelis’ Sierre is located in the Valais Switzerland employing around 550 people. It mainly focuses on production of aluminium sheet for the automotive market covering the entire process from casting to finishing. The plant also hosts a world-leading Research & Innovation Center specialized in the development of new automotive sheet alloys surface treatment and joining technologies. In Feburary 2022 together with research institutions and a local energy provider Novelis founded the Net Zero Lab Valais to develop carbon-neutral solutions for aluminium manufacturing. The lab focuses on identifying and implementing innovative solutions to neutralize the carbon footprint of Novelis’ manufacturing operations and neighboring communities starting in Sierre.
 The Sierre plant supports its community through direct sponsorship of many annual events promoting education sports and culture.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Notre centre de recherche et de technologie situé à Sierre, dans le canton du Valais (Suisse), recherche un métallurgiste possédant des compétences dans le développement d'alliages automobiles (séries 5xxx et 6xxx) ainsi que dans la recherche fondamentale. Vous participerez au développement des futures générations de produits en aluminium pour l’automobile et à l’amélioration continue des procédés de fabrication déployés au sein du réseau mondial des usines Novelis.

Vos responsabilités:

• Diriger des projets stratégiques de développement de nouveaux produits en aluminium laminé pour le secteur automobile, en mettant l’accent sur la résistance mécanique, les performances au crash, la formabilité et la durabilité des alliages.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes procédés, développement et commerciales, pour définir des produits à forte valeur ajoutée répondant aux besoins du marché.

• Établir des collaborations avec des universités et des consortiums internationaux afin d’accélérer l’innovation et le développement de solutions durables.

• Fournir une expertise technique sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de production de l’aluminium, notamment dans les domaines du laminage à chaud, du laminage à froid et de la finition, afin de soutenir les activités de production.

Comment nous convaincre:

• Master ou doctorat en science des matériaux, métallurgie ou dans un domaine connexe ; une expérience professionnelle pertinente est un atout.
Solide expertise en métallurgie et en caractérisation des matériaux.

• Expérience dans le domaine de l’aluminium et de ses procédés de fabrication ; une expérience dans le secteur automobile est un atout.

• Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.

• Esprit d’équipe dynamique, flexible et innovant, capable d’apprendre rapidement et d’évoluer avec aisance dans des environnements multiculturels.

• Maîtrise de l’anglais ; la maîtrise du français ou de l’allemand est un atout.

Our Research & Technology Center in Sierre, Valais, Switzerland, is seeking a Metallurgy Scientist with expertise in automotive alloy design (5xxx and 6xxx) and fundamental research. You will help address today’s challenges and unlock new opportunities for aluminium sheet in vehicle applications and processing of aluminium in our global plant network.

Your responsabilities:

• Lead projects to develop new rolled aluminium products for the automotive industry, focusing on high strength, crash performance, formability, and sustainable alloy design.

• Collaborate closely with application engineering, development, and commercial teams to define viable product specifications and identify business opportunities.

• Partner with universities and global working groups to develop innovative, long-term material solutions for new design concepts.

• Provide project-based expertise in aluminium processing, including hot rolling, cold rolling, and finishing, to support operations.

How to convince us:

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in materials science, metallurgy, or a related field; relevant work experience is a plus.

• Strong expertise in metallurgy and material characterization.

• Experience with aluminium and its manufacturing processes; automotive experience is an advantage.

• Strong project management skills and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

• A dynamic, flexible, and innovative team player who learns quickly and thrives in multicultural environments.

• Fluent in English; French or German is an advantage.

Please apply before 20th November, 2026.

Location Profile

Novelis’ Sierre is located in the Valais Switzerland employing around 550 people. It mainly focuses on production of aluminium sheet for the automotive market covering the entire process from casting to finishing. The plant also hosts a world-leading Research & Innovation Center specialized in the development of new automotive sheet alloys surface treatment and joining technologies. In Feburary 2022 together with research institutions and a local energy provider Novelis founded the Net Zero Lab Valais to develop carbon-neutral solutions for aluminium manufacturing. The lab focuses on identifying and implementing innovative solutions to neutralize the carbon footprint of Novelis’ manufacturing operations and neighboring communities starting in Sierre.
The Sierre plant supports its community through direct sponsorship of many annual events promoting education sports and culture.
